TVS M1-S Debuts At EICMA - Prod-Spec eScooter, 7″ TFT, 120 km Range

KS
By Kabir Sharma Indian Automotive & SUV Specialist • via Rushlane.com Wire
⚡ Visual Story
Source & Photography: Rushlane.com Wire Dispatch Verified Editorial Asset
⚡ Executive Takeaways & Key Highlights
  • At EICMA 2026, TVS has showcased multiple new products including Norton 450cc , TVS Apache 125 and TVS iQube with Android Auto .
  • And now, the production version of the M1-S maxi-style electric scooter has also been unveiled at the event.
  • M1-S is part of the brand’s broader strategy to strengthen its presence in overseas electric two-wheeler markets, particularly in Europe.
⚡ EDITORIAL TAKE • KABIR SHARMA Indian Automotive & SUV Specialist

Bharat NCAP Safety Standards & Indian Road Readiness

In India's rapidly evolving automotive landscape, crashworthiness and real-world durability are driving consumer purchase decisions like never before. As reported by Rushlane.com, indigenous automakers like Tata Motors and Mahindra are setting global safety benchmarks while optimizing suspension and ground clearance for unpredictable road conditions.

Big Picture: Upcoming monthly FADA retail delivery reports and Bharat NCAP rating scorecards will reveal which domestic models capture mass-market dominance.

At EICMA 2026, TVS has showcased multiple new products including Norton 450cc , TVS Apache 125 and TVS iQube with Android Auto . And now, the production version of the M1-S maxi-style electric scooter has also been unveiled at the event. M1-S is part of the brand’s broader strategy to strengthen its presence in overseas electric two-wheeler markets, particularly in Europe.

📌 The Core Development

With its flamboyant and striking design, TVS M1-S instantly gets your attention. Key features include sharp and layered panelling all across, a prominent front apron, an extra-large windshield and sleek lighting elements. The production-spec model showcased uses a dual-tone white and black colour theme. More colour options are expected when the scooter is launched.

Wheels are orange coloured, which add contrast and ensure a more dynamic presence. Black-finished surfaces utilize a mix of matte black and glossy black. Distinctive graphics have been used in black and orange shades. The scooter uses a single piece seat with a stepped design. The model showcased can be seen with a rack and top box. These are likely to be offered as accessories.

🔍 Background & Sector Context

TVS M1-S has relatively modest specifications and does not appear to be part of the race for higher range and top speed. The focus could be more on accessibility, practical applications, reliability, durability and easy maintenance. The scooter is equipped with a 4.2 kWh lithium-ion NMC battery pack, offering a range of around 120 km (European WMTC testing standards).

The battery is installed in the floorboard, ensuring a low centre of gravity and optimized weight distribution. TVS M1-S uses a permanent magnet synchronous electric motor, bolted on the chassis. It generates 12.5 kW or approximately 17 PS. Continuous output is rated at 5 kW or 6.80 PS. The scooter has a top speed of 105 km/h.

📊 Industry & Real-World Impact

TVS M1-S has a 1.8 kW onboard charger. It can achieve 10% to 80% charge in around 1 hour 15 minutes. Core hardware parts include telescopic front forks and twin rear shock absorbers. Both ends have 14-inch wheels, paired with 110/70 front and 120/70 rear tyres. 230 mm discs have been used on both wheels and dual-channel ABS is being offered as standard.

🔮 Strategic Outlook & What Lies Ahead

With a seat height of 800 mm, TVS M1-S is suited for agile handling across urban environments. It also gets a high ground clearance of 170 mm. The scooter has a kerb weight of 150 kg and comes with 26 litres of underseat storage. At the front, there’s a glovebox and an open compartment for small items.

M1-S is equipped with premium features such as cruise control and a tyre pressure monitoring system. A USB Type-A charging port has been provided at the front. The scooter also gets advanced functions like app-based seat unlocking, key-fob ignition and ‘Find my Bike’. A 7-inch TFT instrument cluster has been used with support for Bluetooth, Wi-Fi and onboard LTE connectivity.
